mentions.name: Behavioral fine-tuning of small LLMs
mentions.description: This project fine-tunes small LLMs for behavioral practices rather than knowledge transfer — training operating habits such as maintaining TODO lists and a scratchpad reflex into the models.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on behavioral fine-tuning of small LLMs. Ie, not fine-tuning or distilling knowledge, but operating practices (TODO lists, scratchpad reflex, etc).
